Observed: the compiled Bolt DAG declares these batches parallel and this run has no fan-out on record for them — batch 2 (2 units: candidate-evidence-inventory, population-interval-accounting), but the audit trail records fan-out rows for [attribution-domain-contracts] and batch-completed convergence for [attribution-domain-contracts], so these units were built one at a time while the plan said they run in parallel.

Why this matters: A parallel batch that runs serially is plan drift the record never shows: across 18 audited intents, 4 declared parallel Bolts and shipped them one at a time, because the plan lived in prose and never became a directive (issue #1892).

Approved exit: Correct the plan, not the run: record the dependency that makes these units serial (with its reason) in unit-of-work-dependency.md, re-run `bun <harness>/tools/amadeus-runtime.ts compile`, then re-run `next`. If the plan is right and the deviation is deliberate, take it to a ruling first.
